from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
# classify each pixel
lab = np.full(im.shape[:2], ' ', dtype='<U1')
lab[(R>230)&(G>230)&(B>220)] = '.'   # near white
lab[(R<50)&(G<50)&(B<50)] = '#'       # black/dark
lab[(R>120)&(G<90)&(B<90)] = 'R'
lab[(R>180)&(G>80)&(G<170)&(B<100)] = 'O'
lab[(R>180)&(G>160)&(B<110)] = 'Y'
lab[(G>100)&(R<130)&(B<130)] = 'g'
lab[(B>110)&(R<130)] = 'b'
lab[(abs(R-G)<25)&(abs(G-B)<25)&(R>=60)&(R<=210)] = 'm'
# print every 2nd row/col? 192x256 -> downscale 2x => 96x128 too wide. Use blocks 4x3
for by in range(0,192,3):
    line=''
    for bx in range(0,256,2):
        block = lab[by:by+3,bx:bx+2].ravel()
        vals,counts=np.unique(block,return_counts=True)
        line+=vals[np.argmax(counts)]
    print(line)
\"
"

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
masks = {
 'red': (R>120)&(G<90)&(B<90),
 'orange': (R>180)&(G>80)&(G<170)&(B<100),
 'yellow': (R>180)&(G>160)&(B<110),
}

    lab,n = ndimage.label(m)

        ys,xs=np.nonzero(lab==i)

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
# near-white (plastic bag?)
white = (R>225)&(G>225)&(B>215)
lab,n = ndimage.label(white)
print('white comps', n)
for i in range(1,n+1):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(lab==i)
    if len(xs)>30:
        print(f'  w{i}: n={len(xs)} x[{xs.min()}-{xs.max()}] y[{ys.min()}-{ys.max()}] cx={xs.mean():.1f} cy={ys.mean():.1f}')
# gray robot parts: gray mask large components
gray = (abs(R-G)<25)&(abs(G-B)<25)&(R>=70)&(R<=210)
lab2,n2 = ndimage.label(gray)
print('gray comps', n2)
res=[]
for i in range(1,n2+1):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(lab2==i)
    if len(xs)>80:
        res.append((len(xs),xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.mean(),ys.mean()))
for r in sorted(res,reverse=True)[:15]:
    print('  g n=%d x[%d-%d] y[%d-%d] cx=%.1f cy=%.1f'%r)
\"
"
